persona: natural-history illustrator: truth to an English oak (bark, limb structure, twig habit, roots), red foxes and a real fox earth; artefacts and implausibility

designs.title: Oak and Fox Earth
designs.why: It has the same oak and the same root faults, the fused rope roots, the orphaned right-hand root system and the face burr. The den now holds a vixen and four cubs, so it reads better from 3 m. Up close, though, the heap of pale bodies merges and you can't trace which back, haunch and tail belong to whom. The two outer cubs are almost the vixen's size, and the chamber has swollen into a cavern no fox earth has. It is a cuter picture and a less truthful one.
designs.fix: Fix the roots as in version 1. Then shrink the outer cubs to clear cub proportions (big head, short muzzle, small body) and part the bodies with a little shadow so each animal reads on its own.
